title: GlyphCard
description: A self-describing, signed, content-addressed capability card. Describes the full card (card depth 'rich'); depth-reduced responses are subsets of this shape.

id.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the card's canonical content. Content-addressed identity.

version.description: The card author's own version string for this capability.

intent.description: A natural-language statement of what the glyph does, written for an LLM consumer.

requiresConfirmation.description: When true, a call is rejected unless it carries a confirmation token from POST /glyphs/:name/prepare.

input.description: A JSON Schema describing the glyph's input.

output.description: A JSON Schema describing the glyph's output.

provider.description: Who authored the tool's behavior. A claim, not a proven identity — see spec/trust.md.

requiredScopes.description: Optional policy scopes required to invoke this glyph. Enters canonical card content.

attestation.description: Optional external evidence of what code is actually running behind the declared contract. The SDK never produces an attestation; it can only verify one against a trust root the consumer already trusts. Enters the canonical content, so a change to it produces a new card id.

type.description: Identifier of the attestation format — conventional: sigstore-bundle, slsa-provenance, in-toto, or a vendor-specific value.

payload.description: The attestation payload, format-specific. Opaque to the SDK.

reference.description: Optional URL or identifier for an external transparency log / store.

publicKey.description: Hex ed25519 public key of the signing server. Present once the card is signed.

signature.description: Hex ed25519 signature over the card id. Present once the card is signed.
